name: Philemon
bio: Philemon is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 4th century BC. Paton's index describes him as the comic poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 450).

poems.title: Book IX, 450: Spoken by Philemon about Euripides
poems.author: Philemon
poems.text: If the dead in truth had use of their senses, as some say, I would have hanged myself to see Euripides.
